name: SBOL Implementation
description: a physical thing that was actually built — the tube in the box, as distinct from the design it was built from
notes: Taken from the SBOL 3 data model, with SBOL's own class and property names — docs/ONTOLOGY.md § Alignment with SBOL. Where this departs from SBOL it says so in this field; silence means it does not depart. Not every SBOL property is modelled yet: what is here is what this lab's work needs, and adding one is adding a field, not a redesign. DEPARTURE, stated: this lab's inventory also needs box and well, which SBOL does not model — a location in a freezer is not a location in a sequence. Those stay in the inventory format for now rather than being invented here as SBOL properties they are not.

built.description: the sbol.component this realises. THE distinction SBOL draws and this repo needed: a Component is pBET8 as a sequence; an Implementation is the tube in cheese_temp C1 that was built from it.

attachments.description: files that came off it — a gel image, a sequencing trace, a plate photo.
